reborn-1221.rationale: Current English text says the opponent cannot change monster battle positions during their next turn, while the engine text explicitly adds 'except with a card effect.' Official Japanese Neuron Q&A clarifies that Mesmeric Control prevents the turn player's ordinary once-per-Main-Phase battle-position changes, but card effects may still change battle positions. The pinned Lua registers the field-level EFFECT_CANNOT_CHANGE_POSITION restriction for the opponent's Monster Zone through the next opponent turn, matching that rule distinction. The two wordings therefore describe the same behavior.

note: Hash-bound wording review using official Neuron Q&A to resolve Mesmeric Control's battle-position wording.
